meta.title: United States active burning observation archive
meta.measurement: Daily unique 5 km equal-area grid cells containing a vegetation-fire detection, separately for each sensor. Monthly values sum daily occupied cells (cell-days), not area burned.

grid.name: Spherical cylindrical equal-area, standard parallel 30 degrees

meta.filter: FIRMS archived science data, type=0 (presumed vegetation fire); all confidence classes retained; within 2025 Census state/DC boundaries. MODIS Terra/Aqua deduplicated together per cell/day. VIIRS uses only Suomi NPP to avoid constellation-size changes.
caveats: Raw MODIS and VIIRS counts remain sensor-dependent and are not scientifically calibrated by this dataset.
Zero means no retained detections in the supplied archive, not proof of no burning or complete clear-sky observation.
Clouds, swath geometry, confidence, revisit frequency and instrument outages affect detection.
Hotspots include wildfire and agricultural or prescribed burns; satellite type=0 does not separate them.
VIIRS Suomi NPP begins 2012-01-20; prior days are null.
MODIS Terra-only in 2001; Aqua joins during 2002.
First and last source detection dates describe detections, not independently verified observation coverage.

Monthly observedDays means dates with any US archive record for that sensor, not verified clear-sky coverage in the selected region. Exclude partial months from sensor-calibration fits or match available days explicitly.
meta.missingObservationDefinition: No records of any fire type in the entire US source file on these dates. These days are null for every region; observation availability is unknown, and instrument outages cannot be established from this file alone.
